name: Sister Mourn
description: A woman who catalogs disasters with the patience of someone who has already seen the ending.
wants: proof that the fountain is remembering names

secrets.content: The fountain repeats names only after someone has paid to erase them.
She can provide access to the Archive's restricted vault in exchange for genuine fountain water.

name: Fennick the Tongue
description: A man who sells secrets he has not yet stolen. His laughter sounds like pages tearing.
wants: a secret he can sell twice

secrets.content: There is a door under the fountain that has been opening itself for three hundred years.
The fountain's door opens into the Breach, but not into the Breach as a place — into the Breach as a when.

name: The Foundling
description: A child who followed something home from the Breach. They are not afraid enough for their own good.
wants: someone to believe what followed them home

secrets.content: The door under the fountain opens into a 'when', not a place. Time moves differently on the other side.

name: The Bell Keeper
description: A keeper who was buried three days ago, but whose bells still ring. Some keepers do not stay buried.
wants: someone to catalog the bells that ring backwards

secrets.content: The bells ring backwards when someone is about to arrive who has already been here.
